meetEvan.title: Hi, I'm Evan 👋
meetEvan.paragraph1: Concept:Coffee might look like a brand, but behind the scenes it's very much a one-man show. I source and roast all the coffees for our workshops, design and lead the experiences, answer the messages—and yes, I'm also the one taking out the trash at the end of the day.
meetEvan.paragraph2: Concept:Coffee was built to make specialty coffee feel accessible, welcoming, and worth caring about. With years of hands-on experience and an SCA roasting certification, my goal is simple: empower everyday coffee drinkers with the knowledge they need to enjoy better coffee—together.

review1.text: Had the pleasure of participating in a coffee workshop at Concept Coffee today. I was a bit skeptical at first, I don't think of myself as a huge coffee person, but I was blown away. Evan is so knowledgeable and he made the topic interesting and approachable. I never really thought much about where my coffee was coming from, how it started out or why it tasted bitter, acidic or a specific flavor. I am going to be paying more attention next time I go to a coffee shop! Thank you Evan!
review1.author: Lynn Burris

review2.text: If anyone is interested at all in coffee and culture, Concept Coffee is a must. The studio is beautiful and the owner is one of the most knowledgeable people about coffee I have ever met. He explained everything so well and it's clear how passionate he is about the subject. The workshop was a very basic introduction to coffee and how we interact with it but I still walked away with a much better understanding about coffee and taste than I previously had. Would absolutely come again next time I'm here.
review2.author: Asher Ackman

review3.text: Evan's passion and expertise for coffee are truly inspiring! I attended a private coffee cupping and latte art workshop and was amazed by how much I learned in such a short time. We explored a variety of unique coffees, each one with its own distinct flavor and story, and Evan guided us through the experience with patience, knowledge, and enthusiasm. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, making the whole session both educational and fun. I can't recommend enough!
review3.author: Amit Avner

whatIsConceptCoffee.question: What is Concept:Coffee?
whatIsConceptCoffee.answer: Concept:Coffee is a specialty coffee education studio and community based in Tel Aviv. We offer hands-on coffee workshops, tastings (cupping), private sessions, and corporate experiences. We give people the tools they need to see coffee as more than just a drink.

whoAreWorkshopsFor.question: Who are Concept:Coffee workshops for?
whoAreWorkshopsFor.answer: Our workshops are designed for curious coffee drinkers, no professional background required. Some sessions are beginner-friendly, while others are more advanced and focus on specific skills like cupping, espresso, or milk texturing.

needPriorExperience.question: Do I need prior coffee experience to attend?
needPriorExperience.answer: No! All of our workshops are accessible to beginners. If a workshop requires prior knowledge, it will be clearly stated in the description.

typesOfWorkshops.question: What types of coffee workshops do you offer?
typesOfWorkshops.answer: We currently offer: Coffee tasting & cupping workshops, Barista & espresso workshops, Latte art workshops, Coffee fundamentals (farm-to-cup), and Private and corporate coffee experiences. If you're interested in a custom coffee workshop covering something not listed here, please be in touch!

workshopLength.question: How long are the workshops?
workshopLength.answer: Most workshops last between 1.5–2 hours, depending on the topic and group size.

peoplePerWorkshop.question: How many people are in each workshop?
peoplePerWorkshop.answer: All workshops are private and can accommodate between 1-12 participants.

areWorkshopsHandsOn.question: Are workshops hands-on?
areWorkshopsHandsOn.answer: Yes. Our workshops are practical, interactive, and experience-driven. You'll taste, brew, compare, ask questions, and actually do things, not just listen.

howToBook.question: How do I book a workshop?
howToBook.answer: All workshops can be booked directly through our website. Payment is made upfront to secure your spot.

cancelOrReschedule.question: Can I cancel or reschedule a workshop?
cancelOrReschedule.answer: Yes. Full refund up to 48 hours before the workshop. Reschedule up to 24 hours before. No refunds within 24 hours of the workshop. Full cancellation terms are listed on the booking page.

transferTicket.question: Can I transfer my ticket to someone else?
transferTicket.answer: Yes, you're welcome to transfer your spot to another person. Just let us know in advance.

offerPrivateWorkshops.question: Do you offer private coffee workshops?
offerPrivateWorkshops.answer: Yes. We offer private workshops for individuals, couples, teams, and special events. These can be tailored to your level, interests, and time frame.

offerCorporateWorkshops.question: Do you offer corporate or office workshops?
offerCorporateWorkshops.answer: Absolutely. We run corporate coffee workshops and experiences for teams, offices, and off-sites, from casual tastings to structured educational sessions.

hostAtVenue.question: Can workshops be hosted at our office or venue?
hostAtVenue.answer: Yes. We can host workshops at your office, event space, or at our studio, depending on the format and group size.

whatCoffeeUsed.question: What kind of coffee do you use in workshops?
whatCoffeeUsed.answer: We use specialty-grade coffees, sourced by founder and roaster Evan Goel with highest transparency and ethical trading practices. Coffees are chosen to clearly demonstrate flavor, processing, and origin differences.

teachHomeBrewing.question: Do you teach home coffee brewing?
teachHomeBrewing.answer: Yes. Many of our workshops focus on improving home coffee — whether that's espresso machines, manual brewing, or understanding grind size, water, and extraction.

languageOfWorkshops.question: Are workshops in Hebrew or English?
languageOfWorkshops.answer: Workshops are offered in Hebrew or English, depending on the group. Language is always specified in advance.

isStudioAccessible.question: Is the studio accessible?
isStudioAccessible.answer: If you have specific accessibility needs, please reach out in advance and we'll do our best to accommodate.

howToContact.question: How can I contact Concept:Coffee?
howToContact.answer: You can reach us through the contact form on the website or via WhatsApp. We're happy to help you choose the right workshop.

baristaPage.intro: Ever dreamed of making café-quality drinks at home—or just want to understand what your barista is actually doing behind the machine? Concept:Barista is our foundational workshop designed for beginners who want to get hands-on with coffee. No gatekeeping, no jargon—just practical skills, explained clearly and practiced together.

baristaPage.learn2: Dialing in: what that means, and how to adjust grind, dose, and time
baristaPage.learn3: The science behind milk steaming and how to pour textured milk

roastingPage.learn1: What roasting actually is—and how it changes the bean, physically and chemically
roastingPage.learn2: How time, temperature, and technique affect flavor

roastingPage.forWho: Expect real equipment, real heat, and real coffee. Plus, each participant takes home a bag of fresh-roasted coffee—straight from the session. aboutPage.title: About The Concept:
aboutPage.intro: At Concept:Coffee, we believe that coffee is more than just a drink—it's an experience. Our mission is to empower everyday coffee drinkers with the tools they need to explore, learn, and perfect the craft of specialty coffee. And now more than ever Coffee Is Better When Shared
aboutPage.evanBio: concept:coffee is my passion project turned small business with big dreams. With over half a decade of experience in coffee and a Specialty Coffee Association roasting certification, I noticed a growing gap between coffee geeks and everyday coffee drinkers, and a lack of an organizer in the specialty coffee community.
aboutPage.evanMission: At concept:coffee, we believe in empowering everyday coffee drinkers through accessible specialty coffee education. A more informed coffee drinker is a better coffee drinker, and coffee is always best when shared.
aboutPage.valuesSubtitle: Our values guide everything we do, from how we source our coffee to how we run our workshops.
aboutPage.missionText: We believe in the power of education and collaboration, and we're here to make specialty coffee more accessible for everyone. Our goal is to build a community that values quality, sustainability, and education, helping people understand that every cup has a story—from farm to cup. At Concept:Coffee, it's about more than just the coffee—it's about building a culture of appreciation, creativity, and knowledge.
aboutPage.studioText: Located at Yonatan Ratosh 2, designed and constructed by founder Evan Goel. The Concept:Coffee Studio is dedicated space where coffee education, creativity, and community collide. Located by the beautiful Jaffa port, our studio is a place where anyone—whether you're a curious beginner or a seasoned enthusiast—can immerse themselves in the world of specialty coffee. This is more than just a studio. It's a creative hub, a learning space, and a community gathering point where people come together to share their love for coffee, creativity, and knowledge.
aboutPage.ctaSubtitle: Whether you're looking to learn a new skill, celebrate a special occasion, or bring your team together—we'd love to meet you.

groupWorkshopsPage.title: Special Classes
groupWorkshopsPage.subtitle: One-off, open-signup coffee classes beyond our regular private offerings. Each month, we host one or two special classes focused on topics that interest us—and gather coffee lovers who want to learn alongside kindred spirits.
groupWorkshopsPage.sectionSubtitle: Open-signup classes designed for individuals and small groups who share a passion for specialty coffee.
groupWorkshopsPage.option1Description: Limited-capacity, open-signup classes hosted once or twice each month. Each class focuses on a specific coffee topic—from advanced tasting to brewing techniques—chosen based on what captures our curiosity.
groupWorkshopsPage.option1Feature2: Open signup—join solo or with friends
groupWorkshopsPage.option2Description: Want something more tailored? Our main offering is custom, private coffee classes for your group, team, or special occasion. Fully personalized to your interests and pace.
groupWorkshopsPage.benefitsDescription: Group workshops are more than just learning—they're about building connection, sparking conversation, and creating lasting memories around something meaningful. Whether you're celebrating a milestone or strengthening team bonds, coffee brings people together.
groupWorkshopsPage.benefit1Description: We work around your schedule. Choose dates, times, and formats that work best for your group.
groupWorkshopsPage.benefit2Description: Mix and match workshops or create something entirely unique tailored to your group's interests and coffee level.
groupWorkshopsPage.benefit3Description: Experience the joy of discovering coffee together, laughing, learning, and creating moments you'll remember.
groupWorkshopsPage.ctaTitle: Ready to Bring Your Group Together?
groupWorkshopsPage.ctaDescription: Whether you're planning a celebration, team event, or just want to share your love of coffee with friends—let's create the perfect experience.
